mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.5% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% monthly indicates stronger consumer spending power, boosting retail and services sector earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 210.5 signals accelerating inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes that increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210.5.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST falling below 1,200 thousand units indicates weakening housing market confidence, reducing construction spending and consumer sector earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS decline below 4.5% and UNRATE drop below 4.0% signals accommodative policy with tight labor markets, increasing corporate profitability and equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.5 AND UNRATE < 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent INDPRO drop below 110 and HOUST decline below 1,200 thousand units indicates manufacturing contraction and reduced consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110 AND HOUST < 1200.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%), RSAFS decline below 380,000 million dollars signals reduced consumer spending capacity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 380000 and regime is late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% and GDPC1 growth < 1.5%), INDPRO drop below 110 signals sector contraction, reducing corporate output and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 110 and regime is manufacturing slowdown.
